openQuestions: Year basis is mixed by necessity: production years where the source infobox gives them, model years otherwise; each generation states which in specificationScope.noteCs.

Mercury never had official European distribution; the relevant European twin is the Ford Cougar (1998-2002, = Mercury Cougar 8th gen) and the Ford Mondeo I (= Mystique). Codex (ford) may want to cross-link.
m-series is a Canadian light/medium truck family (1947-1968); keep in "auto" as pickup or move out?
monterey-minivan is a separate models-auto entry while the line/card keeps it as generations[1] of monterey; decide which shape is canonical.
All 34 cards carry isAddition:true although every line is also in model-lines-auto.json (mirrored in model-line-additions.json), same as pontiac.
montclair photo (Mercury Montclair + Packard Ambulance) shows a second, unrelated vehicle; consider replacing.

Cards remain family-level skeletons: no per-generation split for Cougar, Comet, Monterey, Grand Marquis, Sable etc.; engines, dimensions and trims were not added in this pass. Wikidata API was rate-limited and could not be cross-checked.
summary: Mercury (defunct 2011): all 42 card generations moved from unknown to ended with years and body types from fixed Wikipedia revisions, 4 summaries corrected/completed; 10 concept, trim and generation duplicates proposed for removal from models-auto, founded year 1938 and the missing Marquis models-auto entry proposed.
